- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clio is the Muse of history, daughter of Zeus and Mnemosyne, one of the nine Muses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The nine Muses are Thalia, Melpomene, Terpsichore, Erato, Polyhymnia, Calliope, Urania, and Euterpe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Zeus had a love affair with Mnemosyne that lasted for nine nights, resulting in the birth of the nine Muses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clio is often depicted holding a scroll or a book, signifying the recording of historical events.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clio inspires poets and historians to write down stories of the past.

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Story of Arion, where Clio helped a poet named Arion after he was thrown overboard by sailors.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Love of Pierus, where Pierus fell in love with Clio after losing a singing competition to the Muses.
